method: Go 1.26.2 windows/amd64, AMD Ryzen 5 5500, default GOMAXPROCS=12. Five 100ms benchmark samples per workload in frozen binaries. Execution: three full-result workloads, fixed seed and 128-seed cycle. Encoding: fully prepared result outside timer, ordinary json.Marshal, returned bytes escape. Other runtime optimizations are excluded from these snapshots.

correctness.note: The final integrated suite and race checks are separate. Early focused runs omitted singular TestSystem names; complete tests exposed event JSON decoding loss, fixed before the final confirmed candidates. No fixture was changed.
